translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus a Aefengaar Noa Rhooawe Seig me Riiurhai
Jesus a faingi fengaenniir rhooawe seig me riiurhai a fang ngaeniir nemaenieer me aar manaman pwe repwe asiiur aniu aenneew me aecchipwaar rhooa semwaai.
Iwe a aefengaar noa pwe repwe noa fenaiuw minna Mweoiun Deus nge re aecchipwaar rhooa semwaai.

A aengaeniir pwe, “Esooar minne oawpwe pwigi wooan aaemi saei: oawsoapw pwigi yomi, oawsoapw pweipwog aaemi pwetoaw, oawsoapw pweipwog mwongo, oawsoapw pweipwog senaapiy, oawsoapw pwan pweipwog ssiuwenin mengaagiumi.
Ese tiwegin iya re aetiwaegaemi me ee, oawno noan iimw naan toori aaemi oawpwe siu me reen aepinoamw naan;
iwe nge pwiuneoi na aeremas rese aetiwaegaemi me ee, nge oawwa siusaengi pwiuneoi we nge oawwa iurhiugi noa ppweoniun me wooan pirhemi pwe eew atapeonneog ngaeniir.”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra noa fetaen noan aepinoamw kkewe, ra noa fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai we nge re aecchipwaar aeremesaen oanongaen pwiuneoi.
Aaen Erotes Pwurhopwurh Fetaen
Oatowe Erotes, we soamwoonin Galilee, e rongorong minikkewe a wen a igin pwurhopwurh fetaen, pwe aaemweoi re iura pwe John Baptist a menaw sefaaen.
Aaemweoi re iura pwe Elijah minne a pwaeto, iwe nge pwan aaemweoi re iura pwe erhai profeta kkewe mweoiwe minne a menaw sefaaen.
Erotes a iura pwe, “John iwe iya gopiy noa iiuwaen, nge iyo mwaaeneei i rongorong kkepesan?” Iwe a aekkaetemaegini fetaeneei aan epwe noa weri Jesus.
Jesus e Oamwongoor Nimingeras Aeremas
Iwe ra sefaaeneto oapostonus kkewe ra itto aengaeni Jesus meeta kkewe ra feeori. A wummwuur, iwe iir rhag ra noa reen eew aepinoamw itan Bethsaida.
Igiwe pwuwaen aeremas we ra rongorong ra pwan ttapw noa mwirin. Jesus a aewenimmwaar, a fenaiuw ngaeniir wunuunun minna Mweoiun Deus iwe nge e aecchipwaar rhooakka re semwaai.

Noan faefin we nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra itto reen nge ra aengaeni pwe, “E igin anug noa igeei nge a pwan pwoong. Aefengaar noa aeremas kaan nee aepinoamw pwe repwene noa sipegin chuwaai aeneer mwongo.”

Jesus a faer aengaeniir pwe, “Oawfang ngaeniir aeneer.” Nge ra iura pwe, “Niffai rhag fenoawa me riiurhai iig minne eno remaem. Wo mwerhaen pwe aeipwe noa nge aeiya noa chuwaai to aeneer rhooanap een?”
(Repwe nimingeras mwaaen reno igiwe.) Jesus a aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Oaw aengaeniir pwe repwe mooat tiw nge repwe aenimeig aeremas noan eew me eew pwoatu.”
Weni mwirin aar rhooan kkayeo kkewe feeori miniwe,

nge Jesus a pwigi fenoawa kkewe niffai me iig kkewe riiurhai, a fattae naaeng nge a fang ngaeni Deus aan aerhigerhig. Iwe a giniiy fenoawa kkewe nge a fang ngaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe pwe repwe inetiy wooar aeremas kkewe.
Oanongeer nge ra maegin mwongo iwe ra mat noa. Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra oawuta seig me ruwowu rhiug reen nuseg kkewe.
Peter e Iura pwe Jesus Iwe Kristus
Igiwe Jesus noa rhag aan noa maeipin, rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra noa itto reen. Iwe a aeiyegiir, “Aeremas re iura pwe ngaang iyo?”
Ra paniuwaeni, “Aaemweoi re iura pwe een John Baptist, nge aekkaaemweoi re iura pwe een Elijah, nge pwan aekkaaemweoi re iura pwe een erhai profeta kkewe mweoiwe nge wa menaw sefaaen.”
A aeiineeor pwe, “Nge aaemi, oaw iura pwe ngaang iyo?” Peter a paniuwaeni pwe, “Een Kristus we Naiun Deus.”
Jesus a Aepesa Waeiraesin me Maenoan
Jesus a aetiwenigiy ngaeniir pwe resoapw aengaeni mwo nge erhai minneei.

Nge a pwan aengaeniir pwe, “Mwaaen na Naiun Aeremas ina epwe gin affayeo nge e serhoawun me neeiir mwaaen kkewe aar me soamwoonin patere me sinsein anniug. Repwene niiy noa nge eoniuraen mwirin nge a menaw sefaaen.”
Nge a aengaeniir oanongeer pwe, “Erhai ne e mwerhaen tapweaei, epwe aerheei noa niunniuwaennen wooan oanongan, a aiufera aan kurus oanongaen raaenin, nge a tapweeito mwiriy.
Pwe iyo e mwerhaen ammwarhiu menewan, epwe ppiung saengi. Nge iyo eppiung saengi menewan pwonno ngaang, epwe giuneei menaw.
Epwe yor ipitan igine eyo ngaeniug oanongan noa faeinaengiy nge a soano saengiug menewoamw? Esooar ipitan!
Aere wosaew aeginiaei me fenai kka aaei, ina nge mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas epwe pwan saew aeginiug igine a noa itto noan nningen me nningen mwaaen na Seman me nningeer angkenus kena re santus.
Ipwe aniugiuniugiuw ngaenigaemi pwe eyor aaemweoi aeremas igeei resoapw mae toori oatona repwe weri minna Mweoiun Deus.”
Nniuwen Noan Wunuunun Jesus
Epwe eew noa week mwirin aan Jesus aepesa minikkeei, nge a pwigiir Peter, John, me James ra ittae maeipin wooan eew rhug.
Oatowe e maeipin, a nniuwen noa wunuunun wooan mesan, nge miniwe mengaagiun a marettin pwerhepwerh noa.
Ese mmwaei mwo nge riiurhai mwaaen ra itto mwaenieniy ngaeni. Iir Moses me Elijah,
repwaeto noan nning seramram nge ra itto mwaenieniy ngaeni Jesus reen wunuunun aan epwene pwaeritae aaen Deus koat reen aan epwe mae noa me noan Jerusalem.
Peter me rhooawe rhoaniuwan ra igin maiur, nge renoa mmasetae ra weri miniwe seramramaen nningen Jesus me mwaaen kkewe riiurhai iwe re iu oaron.

Igiwe mwaaen kkewe riiurhai ra siunoa, nge Peter a aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Sinsei, a igin gacch pwe sino igeei. Aeipwe aiuwtae enuuw iimw tampwoning, eew imwoamw, eew imwaen Moses, me eew imwaen Elijah.” (Ese metefaaegini faaen minikkiwe e aepesa.)
Igiwe e rhiuwen kkepas, a itto eew toapw pwaniiur noa faaen niuriun; rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra mesag reen toapw we a itto pwaniiur noa.
Eew mangiungiu a noa ittiw me noan toapw we, “Ieen mwaaen e naeyi, iye iya finitae — oaw aiussaening ngaeni!”
Iwe mangiungiu we a iug noa, iwe a Jesus noa rhag. Rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra anniug aegini noa rhag miniwe, nge esooar mwo erhai ne re aengaeni meeta we ra weri reen oatowe.
Jesus e Aecchipwa Erhai Aetemwaaen Eyor Aniu Aenneew Wooan
Mmasetaen raaen we eraaen nge Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe eoniurhai ra ittiw me wooan rhug we, nge eew pwuwa temoag ra itto reen Jesus.
Erhai mwaaen a aekkepwas me noan pwuwa we, “Sinsei! Faaen pirhemw, itto pipiiy aet e naeyi — ieen rhag naeyi mwaaen!
Oate aniu aenneew een epwe kkaein tiw wooan, nge e rhiuwen apwas rhag nge a ittiw cchech fetaen, pwuropwur wow noan ewan; e aewwaeiraesi fetaeneei rhag nge esa siusaengi no!
Iya aeffaenipirhe ngaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe noawumw pwe repwe oatowowuw, nge ese mmwen ngaeniir.”

Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Ifa mwo aaemi se niugiuniug me ruguppin faaen oateei! Epwe ifa ssiunaein aaei ipwe no reemi? Epwe ifa wusun aaei noaneenaei reemi?” Iwe nge a aengaeni mwaaen we pwe, “Pwigito aetemwu noawumw iga.”

Igiwe aetewe a itto reen nge aniu aenneew we a aerheitiw wooan ppweon a ittiw cchech fetaen. Jesus a aerh ngaeni aniu aenneew we pwe epwe toowow, iwe a aecchipwa aet we, iwe a iseni sefaaeniy ngaeni mwaaen we seman.

Oanongeer rhooawe ra mwaar reen maemaewaen kkemenaen Deus. Jesus a Pwan Aepesa Wunuunun Aan Maenoa (Mat 17.22-23; Mark 9.30-32) Oanongeer aeremas kkewe nge ra riutae reen meeta kkewe Jesus a feeori nge a aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe,
“Oawteorh maniuwegini minne ipwe aengaenigaemi! Mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas epwene yonong nee paiiur aeremas.”
Iwe nge iir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun rese metefaaegini faaen miniwe mwaenian. Miniwe ekooap saengiir pwonno rete metefaaegini, iwe iir ra mesag pwe repwe aeiyeg.
Iyo e Oarosaen Taegias?
Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe ra aengiingi fengaen neeiir ngaere iyo e oarosaen taegias.
Jesus a giuneei niunniuwaen kkewe aar, iwe a pwigi erhai wonigaet a aiuw tiw oaron,

a aengaeniir pwe, “Iyo e aetiwa aeteen faaen itaei, ina e aetiwaeyaei; nge iyo erhai ne e aetiwaeyaei, ina e aetiwa aeremas na efangeto ngaang. Pwe iyo na oarosaen sessoan neeimi nge ina iiy minne oarosaen taegias.”
Iyo na Ese Appaniuwaenigaemi Nge Ina Rhoaniuwaemi
John a iura pwe, “Sinsei, aeiweri erhai mwaaen e oatowowuw aniu aenneew faaen itoamw, nge aeiya aengaeni pwe epwe iug noa pwe saapw iiy rhoaniuwarh.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Oawsoapw aiugiu noa, pwe iyo na ese appaniuwaenigaemi ina rhoaniuwaemi.”
Eew Aepinoamwon Samaria Ese Aetiwa Jesus
Igiwe a arapeto oaton aaen Jesus noa naaeng, a aettiweginiy nee tipan epwe noa Jerusalem.
A fangenoa rhooan pweipwogin kkepas repwe noa wooan eew aepinoamw me Samaria repwe noa oamoannatae oanongaen meeta me weni mmwan.
Iwe nge aeremesaen pwiuneoi we rese mwerhaen aetiwa pwe igiwe epwae ngaeniir pwe epwene noa Jerusalem.
Igiwe James me John ra giuneei miniwe ra aengaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, wo mwerhaen pwe aeipwe tingoar noa aengaet naaeng pwe epwe ittiw figiir noa?”
Jesus a toagun ngaeniir a soong ngaeniir.
Iwe Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra noa wooan eew noa aepinoamw.
Rhooan Mwerhaen Tapweei Mwirin Jesus
Igiwe ra noa erhai mwaaen a aengaeni Jesus, “Ese tiwegin iga wopwe noa ee nge ngaang ipwe tapweog.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Fox eyor ngeteer, man aeniaen eyor feseer, iwe nge mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas esooar eew pwiuneoi ne epwe noa wonotiw aseoseo ee.”
Jesus a pwan aengaeni erhai mwaaen, “Itto tapweaei.” Iwe mwaaen we a paniuwaeni pwe, “Soamwoon, mmwaen fang mwo ngaang ipwe sefaaen noa nipwaeni noa mwaaen na semaei.”
Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Nigitiir rhooa mae repwe sipegin nipwaeni aar mae. Nge een wa noa arheoiuwa fetaeneei kkepesaen minna Mweoiun Deus.”
Pwan erhai mwaaen a iura, “Menap, ipwe tapweog; nge ipwe mmwaen noa mwo oapwongiir aaei famini.”
Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Erhai ne epwe rhaepetae aan engaengaen maat nge e feffan sefaaen nge iiy esoapw firh ngaeni minna Mweoiun Deus.”
